blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
MemoCare is an interactive mobile system for automated multimodal cognitive screening. A React Native application combines spoken responses, temporal and spatial orientation, touchscreen actions, and visuoconstruction in complete English and Vietnamese workflows. Speech is transcribed by Google Speech-to-Text and scored locally with deterministic task-specific natural language processing rules; GPS coordinates are resolved by the MemoCare spatial module before answer matching; touch tasks are scored from interaction events; and the drawing task uses a three-model convolutional neural network consensus with separate visual interpretation.
Software tests pass 151/151 predefined cases across speech/language, spatial-answer, and touch-interaction scoring, while spatial regression passes 48/48 four-country coordinate-resolution cases. For the drawing module, validation-selected ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 achieved 91.33% mean balanced accuracy and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy on a locked 71-image test set.
Four clinician co-authors additionally inspected the end-to-end workflow, yielding a pooled median rating of 4/5 across eight criteria, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5.
At MMM, attendees can directly try a shortened multimodal screening workflow and inspect automatic item-level and total scoring.
blocks.zh:
MemoCare是一个用于自动化多模式认知筛选的交互式移动系统. 反应原生应用程序结合了口语反应,时间和空间取向,触摸屏动作,以及完整英语和越南语工作流程的粘接. Speech由Google Speech-to-Text转写并在当地用定型任务特有自然语言处理规则打分;GPS坐标由MemoCare空间模块解决后再进行答题比对;触摸任务由交互事件打分;绘图任务使用三种模式的分化神经网络共识,分别进行视觉解释.
软件测试通过 151/151 预先定义的个案,跨越了语音/语言,空间答案,和触动交互分数,而空间回归则通过48/48 四国协调解例. 对于绘图模块,所选择的验证-ShuffleNetV2 x1.5在锁定的71-图像测试集上实现了91.33%的平衡精度和78.87%的精确三克精度.
4名临床医生合著者还检查了端到端的工作流程,在8个标准中得出了4/5的集合中位数,项目水平中位数从3到4.5不等。
在MMM,参与者可以直接尝试缩短多模式筛选工作流程并检查自动项目级别和总分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cognitive screening combines heterogeneous interactions within a single assessment. Established tests such as the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE) include spoken responses, orientation to time and place, memory and calculation, commanded actions, language, and visuoconstruction [ 3 ] . Mobile automation must therefore do more than display a questionnaire: it must capture different response types, interpret each according to task-specific semantics, and integrate them into a coherent scoring workflow.
blocks.zh: 认知筛选结合了单一评估中的各种相互作用。 诸如小型牙科国家考试之类的既定测试包括口头回答、时间和地点的取向、记忆和计算、指令行动、语言和预言[3]。 因此,移动自动化必须不止显示问卷:它必须捕捉不同的响应类型,根据任务特定的语义来解释每个类型,并将它们融入一个连贯的评分工作流程.

blocks.en: Digital cognitive tests and speech-assisted mobile cognitive-screening implementations have been explored previously [ 1 , 2 ] , while multimodal research systems have combined several sensing modalities to capture richer behavioral signals [ 6 ] . MemoCare instead focuses on a compact, directly interactive mobile workflow. Its contributions are: (i) a modality-aware automated scoring architecture for speech, location, touch, and drawing interactions; (ii) task-specific processing with a unified scoring interface; and (iii) an end-to-end mobile prototype with technical verification and formative inspection by four clinician co-authors. This combination directly addresses the MMM demo track through interactive multimodal processing and attendee interaction in a medical application. MemoCare is presented as a research prototype, not as a validated diagnostic system.
blocks.zh: 以前曾探索过数字认知测试和语音辅助移动认知筛选执行[1,2],而多模式研究系统结合了几种感知模式来捕捉更丰富的行为信号[6]. 备忘录则侧重于一个紧凑、直接互动的移动工作流程。 其贡献有:(一) 语音,位置,触摸和绘图互动的有模式意识的自动打分架构;(二) 有统一打分接口的任务特定处理;以及(三) 有四个临床专家合著者进行技术核查和成型检查的端到端移动原型. 这种组合直接处理MMM演示音轨,在医疗应用程序中通过交互多模式处理和参与者互动. MemoCare被作为研究原型,而不是作为经过验证的诊断系统来呈现.

blocks.en: 2 MemoCare System
blocks.zh: 2 医疗系统

blocks.en: MemoCare presents task-specific interactions and routes each response to the corresponding processing module (Fig. 1 ). The workflow covers temporal and spatial orientation, memory, attention and calculation, language, touch-based commands, and visuoconstruction. Some interactions are adapted to mobile input while preserving the cognitive operation. Users can repeat, skip, pause, and resume tasks; after completion, the app shows item-level and total scores.
blocks.zh: MemoCare介绍针对特定任务的互动和对相应处理模块的每个响应路径(图1. 工作流程涵盖时间和空间取向、内存、注意力和计算、语言、以触摸为主的命令以及粘接结构。 一些相互作用在保留认知操作的同时被适应于移动输入. 用户可以重复,跳过,暂停,并恢复任务;完成后,应用程序会显示项目级别和总分.

blocks.en: Figure 1: MemoCare architecture. (A) Speech, location, touch, and drawing are captured in one mobile app. (B) Specialized modules perform language scoring, geospatial reasoning, touch verification, and vision inference. (C) Item scores are aggregated into total score and local history.
blocks.zh: 图1: MemoCare架构. (A) 演讲、位置、触摸和绘图在一个移动应用程序中被捕获。 (B) 专门模块进行语言评分、地理空间推理、触摸验证和视觉推论。 (C)项目分数汇总为总分和当地历史.

blocks.en: The client is implemented in React Native for Android and iOS, with Android used for the live demonstration. Speech is captured through the microphone, touch events and drawings through the display, and location through the device GPS service. Google Speech-to-Text (STT) is used for speech transcription, while AWS-hosted inference is used for drawing analysis. The demo prototype does not require user accounts; assessment state and results are stored locally on the device. The processing modules expose a common item-scoring interface, allowing individual components to be updated without changing the mobile flow.
blocks.zh: 该客户端由Android和iOS的React Introduct执行,Android用于现场演示. 语音通过麦克风被捕获,触摸事件和绘图通过显示,位置通过设备GPS服务被捕获. Google Speech-to-Text(STT)用于语音转录,而AWS托管的推论用于绘图分析. 演示原型不需要用户账户;评估状态和结果在当地存储在设备上. 处理模块暴露出一个常见的项目评分界面,允许单个组件在不改变移动流量的情况下被更新.

blocks.en: The workflow is designed to run on the phone without requiring continuous examiner control. Each item combines a localized spoken instruction with the required input channel and a task-specific completion condition. If no usable response is detected, the application issues reminders, allows the instruction to be repeated, and can continue to the next item after repeated non-response. Stateful tasks retain information across sequential responses when later scoring depends on earlier responses. The English and Vietnamese versions use the same interaction app flow while language-specific scripts, normalization rules, and spatial vocabularies adapt the workflow to each setting.
blocks.zh: 工作流程的设计是为了在不需要持续检查者控制的情况下在电话上运行. 每个项目将本地化的口语教学与所需的输入通道和特定任务完成条件相结合. 如果没有发现可用的响应,应用程序会发出提醒,允许指令被重复,并在重复不响应后可以继续到下一项. 说明性任务保留了顺序答复中的信息,而以后的评分取决于先前的答复。 英文版和越南文版在语言特有脚本,常态规则和空间词汇调整工作流程以适应每个设置时使用相同的交互应用.

blocks.en: 3 Multimodal Processing and Scoring
blocks.zh: 3 多式联运加工和分红

blocks.en: 3.1 Speech and Language Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.1 语音和语言分数

blocks.en: Most verbally answered tasks are processed through the same pipeline. Audio is trimmed and transcribed by Google STT, then normalized and passed to deterministic task-specific scoring rules. These include date and number parsing, stateful sequential calculation, multi-target recall matching, ordered phrase matching, and sentence-completeness checks. Hesitations and repetitions are tolerated through task-specific rules, while language-specific normalization handles common transcription and lexical variants. For selected tasks, scoring prioritizes recognized task-relevant words and does not infer negation or correction from potentially incomplete STT transcripts.
blocks.zh: 大多数口头回答的任务都是通过同一管道处理的。 音频由Google STT进行修剪并转录,后被规范化并传递给决定性任务特定评分规则. 其中包括日期和数字解析,状态相继计算,多目标回想匹配,命令的短语匹配,以及句子完成性检查等. 通过任务特定规则来容忍犹豫和重复,而语言特定正常化处理常见的抄写和词汇变体. 对于选定的任务,评分优先处理与任务有关的公认词,不推断否定或更正可能不完整的STT记录。

blocks.en: The scoring module combines both the normalized transcript and the task state, allowing sequential responses while keeping speech recognition separate from task-specific scoring logic.
blocks.zh: 评分模块既结合了规范的语录,又结合了任务状态,允许相继回复,同时将语音识别与任务特定评分逻辑区分开来.

blocks.en: 3.2 Location-Aware Spatial Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.2 了解位置的空间原因

blocks.en: Spatial-orientation responses depend on the phone position and may remain valid after administrative renaming or boundary changes. The MemoCare spatial module uses 89,043 administrative boundary records across Vietnam, Switzerland, China, and the United States. Administrative geometries are indexed spatially so that candidate regions near the device location are retrieved before point-in-polygon testing, rather than scanning the complete geometry collection.
blocks.zh: 空间定向响应取决于电话位置,在行政更名或边界变化后可能仍然有效。 MemoCare空间模块使用89,043个跨越南,瑞士,中国和美国的行政边界记录. 行政几何在空间上进行索引,以便在点入-多相测试前检索设备位置附近的候选区域,而不是扫描完整的几何集合.

blocks.en: For a resolved location, the module returns accepted current and historical place names. These are normalized and matched against the STT transcript using exact and approximate name matching, allowing administrative aliases and renamed regions to be accepted where appropriate. Administrative boundary data were derived from OpenStreetMap, using country extracts obtained through the Geofabrik download service.
blocks.zh: 对于一个已解决的地点,模块返回接受当前和历史地名。 通过准确和大致的名称匹配,使这些文字与STT记录相符,以便酌情接受行政别名和重新命名的区域。 行政边界数据取自OpenStreetMap,使用通过Geofabrik下载服务获得的国家摘要.

blocks.en: 3.3 Touch Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.3 触摸相互作用

blocks.en: For mobile-adapted action tasks, MemoCare scores recorded touchscreen events instead of speech. One interaction verifies a multi-step tap-and-drag sequence using action type, target, and event order; another verifies whether a touch falls within a predefined target region on a displayed image. The module checks the recorded events against task-specific interaction rules. All touch processing is performed locally without a camera or additional sensor.
blocks.zh: 对于可移动适应的动作任务,MemoCare的分数记录了触摸屏事件而不是语音. 一个交互用动作类型,目标,和事件顺序验证多步相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 该模块对照特定任务的互动规则检查所记录的事件. 所有触摸处理都在当地进行,没有相机或额外的传感器.

blocks.en: 3.4 Drawing Representation and Data
blocks.zh: 3.4 绘图代表性和数据

blocks.en: For the visuoconstruction component, a geometric reference is presented on screen and the user reproduces it directly on the touchscreen. The captured bitmap is resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels for convolutional neural network (CNN) inference. Automated analysis uses three internal structural criteria, C1–C3, representing component-shape validity and two spatial-relation conditions. These criteria are used for model training and interpretation, while the application exposes only the configured binary item result. The binary item result is positive only if all three criteria C1–C3 are satisfied.
blocks.zh: 对于粘接组件,屏幕上呈现出几何参考,用户直接在触摸屏上复制. 被捕获的位图被调整为224×224\times 224像素,用于演化神经网络(CNN)推论. 自动化分析使用三个内部结构标准C1-C3,代表组件-形状有效性和两个空间-关系条件. 这些标准被用于模型培训和解释,而应用程序只暴露了所配置的二进制项目结果. 二进制项目的结果只有在满足了所有三个标准C1-C3的情况下才会是正数.

blocks.en: Because the manually drawn training set was limited, we developed a rule-based generator that produces geometric copying examples with known C1/C2/C3 labels. Four generation stages produced 45,724 images covering valid and invalid structures, relation errors, hard negatives, and visual variations such as blur, perspective, shadow, texture, and missing edges.
blocks.zh: 由于人工绘制的训练集是有限的,我们开发出一个基于规则的生成器,生成有已知C1/C2/C3标签的几何复制实例. 4个生成阶段共产生了45,724个图像,覆盖了有效而无效的结构,关系错误,硬底片,以及模糊,视角,阴影,纹理等视觉变化和缺失边缘.

blocks.en: The researcher-created development dataset contained 329 training, 66 validation, and 71 locked-test drawings, manually drawn and labeled according to the predefined C1/C2/C3 criteria. Because criterion distributions are imbalanced, evaluation uses balanced accuracy (BA), the average of sensitivity and specificity. Mean BA averages the three criterion-specific BAs, while exact three-criterion accuracy requires all C1–C3 predictions for the same drawing to be correct.
blocks.zh: 研究人员创建的开发数据集包含329个训练,66个验证,71个锁定测试图纸,按照预先定义的C1/C2/C3标准手动绘制并贴上标签. 由于标准分布不平衡,评价使用平衡的精确度(BA),即敏感性和特异性的平均值. 平均BA平均值为三个标准特定BA,而准确的三克精确度要求同一图纸的所有C1-C3预测正确.

blocks.en: 3.5 Vision Models and Deployment
blocks.zh: 3.5 远景模式和部署

blocks.en: We evaluated eight lightweight CNN models with ImageNet-pretrained weights from four architecture families: ShuffleNetV2 [ 8 ] , MobileNetV3 [ 5 ] , EfficientNet-B0 [ 11 ] , EfficientNet-Lite [ 7 ] variants, and MnasNet [ 10 ] . Each model predicts C1–C3 probabilities, is first trained on the staged synthetic dataset, and is subsequently fine-tuned on the manually drawn training set.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了八个有线电视新闻网的轻量级模型, ShuffleNetV2 [8], MobileNetV3 [5],高效 Net-B0 [11],高效网-Lite [7]变体,和MnasNet [10]. 每个模型都预测出C1-C3概率,首先在相接的合成数据集上进行训练,随后在人工绘制的训练集上进行微调.

blocks.en: For each model and criterion, the 66-image validation set is used to select probability calibration and decision thresholds. Raw and temperature-scaled probabilities are compared [ 4 ] , with bootstrap resampling used to identify stable threshold ranges before final evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型和标准,使用66-图像验证集来选择概率校正和决定阈值. 将原始概率和温度尺度概率作一比较[4],在最后评价之前,用靴子重新取样确定稳定的阈值范围。

blocks.en: The drawing inference service is exposed through a stable AWS endpoint so that the mobile client remains independent of the selected vision backbone. A separate criterion-aware U-Net [ 9 ] provides structured visual interpretation of component shapes and spatial-relation regions. This explanatory model does not affect the binary drawing score.
blocks.zh: 绘图推断服务通过稳定的AWS端点被曝光,这样移动客户端仍然独立于所选的视觉主干. 一个单独的具有标准意识的U-Net[9]提供了对组件形状和空间-关系区域的结构化视觉解释. 此解释模型不影响二进制绘图分数.

blocks.en: 4 Technical Verification and Expert Review
blocks.zh: 4 技术核查和专家审评

blocks.en: Table 1: Technical verification and expert inspection.
blocks.zh: 表1:技术核查和专家视察。

blocks.en: 4.1 Technical Verification
blocks.zh: 4.1 技术核查

blocks.en:
The current test suite passed 151/151 cases: 138 speech/language, 8 spatial-answer, and 5 touch/action cases. Spatial regression additionally passed 48/48 fixed-coordinate cases across the four supported countries. The speech/language tests start from STT transcripts and therefore evaluate downstream scoring logic rather than Google STT accuracy.
Table 1 summarizes the main software, vision, and expert-review results.
blocks.zh:
目前的测试套间通过了151/151个案例:138个语音/语言、8个空间回答和5个触摸/行动案例。 空间回归在4个支助国家还通过了48/48个固定坐标案例。 语音/语言测试从STT记录稿开始,因此评价下游评分逻辑而不是谷歌STT的准确性.
表1概述了主要软件、愿景和专家审评结果。

blocks.en: For drawing evaluation, model selection, probability calibration, and threshold settings, we used the 66-image validation set. ShuffleNetV2 x1.5 ranked first on validation mean BA at 96.23% and was therefore selected as the single-model result. On the locked 71-image test set, it achieved 91.33% mean BA and 78.87% exact three-criterion accuracy. The locked test was not used for model selection, calibration, or threshold tuning.
blocks.zh: 在绘制评价,模型选择,概率校正,和阈值设置时,我们使用了66-图像验证集. ShuffleNetV2 x1.5在验证中以96.23%的成绩位列BA第一,并因此被选为单模型结果. 在锁定的71-图像测试集上,它实现了91.33%的BA和78.87%的准确三克的精确度. 锁定的测试没有用于模型选择、校正或阈值调试。

blocks.en: Following the single-model evaluation, MobileNetV3-Large, EfficientNet-B0, and EfficientNet-Lite1 were combined in a post-hoc consensus based on complementary performance observed across the completed evaluation results. The conditional consensus achieved a descriptive 95.17% mean BA on the locked test set. Because the consensus was configured after reviewing the locked-test results, its performance on the same 71 images is descriptive rather than confirmatory.
blocks.zh: 单一模式评价之后,MobileNetV3-Large、高效率的Net-B0和高效率 网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网-网 有条件的共识在锁定测试集上实现了描述性95.17%的BA. 由于共识是在审查了锁定测试结果后配置的,因此它在同71个图像上的性能是描述性的,而不是证实性的.

blocks.en: 4.2 Clinical Expert Inspection
blocks.zh: 4.2 临床专家检查

blocks.en:
Four clinicians, one in geriatrics and three in neurology, independently evaluated the complete application using an end-to-end workflow with mock responses.
Eight 5-point criteria assessed fidelity of the digital workflow, clarity of instructions, suitability of voice and touchscreen interaction, agreement of automated scoring with clinical judgment, transparency of item-level results, availability of repeat/skip/pause/resume controls, and readiness for formal clinical evaluation.
blocks.zh:
四名临床医生,一名在老年病科,三名在神经学科,利用有模拟反应的端到端工作流程,独立评价了完整的应用.
八项5分标准评估了数字工作流程的诚实性、说明的明确性、语音和触摸屏互动的适宜性、与临床判断一致的自动评分、项目层面结果的透明度、重复/斯基普/暂停/恢复控制,以及正式临床评价的准备程度。

blocks.en:
The pooled median rating was 4/5, with item-level medians ranging from 3 to 4.5.
The highest-rated aspects were the overall digital workflow, clarity of instructions, and touchscreen interaction, each with a median of 4.5/5.
Voice interaction and readiness for formal clinical evaluation received medians of 4/5, while agreement of automated scoring with clinical judgment, availability of interaction controls, and transparency of item-level results received medians of 3.5, 3.5, and 3/5, respectively.
The separate overall-readiness rating had a median of 4/5 (range 3–4).
Reviewers mainly identified improvements related to speech recognition and response handling, acceptable-response handling and task instructions, drawing interaction, and access to recorded responses.
These findings characterize expert inspection of the implemented workflow rather than patient-level diagnostic performance.
blocks.zh:
集合中位数为4/5,项目级别中位数从3到4.5不等。
评级最高的方面是总体数字工作流程,指令的清晰度,和触摸屏交互,每个中位数为4.5/5.
语音互动和正式临床评价准备程度的中位数为4/5,而自动评分与临床判断、互动控制可用性以及项目级结果透明度的中位数分别为3.5、3.5和3/5。
单独的总体准备程度评级中位数为4/5(范围为3至4)。
审查者主要查明了与语音识别和反应处理、可接受的反应处理和任务指示、绘制互动图以及查阅记录答复有关的改进。
这些调查结果是专家对已执行的工作流程而不是病人一级诊断表现的检查。

blocks.en: 5 Live Demonstration and Requirements
blocks.zh: 5 现场示范和要求

blocks.en:
At MMM, attendees use an Android phone or tablet and can skip among representative tasks. The short path shows speech transcription and local scoring, GPS-based spatial scoring, touch tasks, drawing scoring with visual interpretation, and inspection of item-level and total results.
The complete workflow can also be explored without the shortened path. Because the system is end-to-end, attendees see not only the final score but also the transition from interaction to modality-specific processing and item result. The demo requires a microphone, location access, and Wi-Fi; internet access is required for Google STT and remote drawing inference. No additional sensors or special space are required.
blocks.zh:
在MMM,参与者使用Android手机或平板电脑,可以在代表性任务中跳过. 短道速滑显示语音抄写和局部分数,基于GPS的空间分数,触摸任务,用视觉判读来绘制分数,并检查项目级别和总结果.
也可以在没有缩短路径的情况下探索完整的工作流程. 由于系统是端到端的,参与者不仅看到最终分数,还看到从交互到模式特定处理和项目结果的过渡. 演示需要麦克风、位置访问和Wi-Fi;Google STT和远程绘图推断需要互联网访问。 不需要额外的传感器或特殊空间。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: MemoCare integrates speech, spatial context, touch, and drawing into one automated multimodal mobile cognitive-screening workflow. The system combines deterministic language scoring, historically aware spatial resolution, event-based touch verification, and a conditional CNN consensus with separate criterion-aware visual interpretation. Technical verification covers the modality-specific components and clinical experts inspect the end-to-end workflow. The modular design keeps the interaction workflow independent of any particular speech, spatial, touch, or vision implementation, supporting the replacement of individual processing components. The live demo exposes this complete multimodal interaction and scoring loop to MMM attendees; formal patient-level clinical validation remains future work.
blocks.zh: MemoCare整合了语音,空间上下文,触摸,并被引入一个自动化的多模式移动认知筛选工作流程. 该系统结合了决定性语言评分,历史意识空间分辨率,事件触摸验证,以及附带条件的CNN共识,分别具有标准意识的视觉解释. 技术核查涵盖特定模式的组成部分,临床专家检查端到端的工作流程. 模块化设计使互动工作流程独立于任何特定的语音,空间,触摸,或视觉执行,支持单个处理组件的替换. 现场演示揭示了这种完整的多模式互动,给MMM参与者打分循环;正式的患者临床验证仍然是未来的工作.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.A Demonstration Video and Setup
blocks.zh: 附录0.A 演示录像和设置

blocks.en: A demonstration video of up to 3 minutes is available at https://youtu.be/INKW6qbg4io . It shows the implemented mobile workflow, major interaction modalities, automated scoring, and the setup used for the conference demonstration.
blocks.zh: 可在https://youtu.be/INKW6qbg4io上观看长达3分钟的演示录像。 它显示已执行的移动工作流程、主要互动模式、自动评分和会议演示所用的设置。

blocks.en: MemoCare runs on an Android phone or tablet. The live demo shows task delivery, spoken-response transcription and scoring, GPS-grounded location scoring, touchscreen task verification, conditional drawing consensus scoring with criterion-level visual interpretation, and item-level and total results. The complete workflow remains available, while a shortened path highlights the major modalities in approximately 3–5 minutes.
blocks.zh: 记忆在Android手机或平板电脑上运行. 现场演示显示任务交付,口语响应转录和评分,GPS定位分数,触摸屏任务验证,有条件地绘制共识分数与标准级视觉解读,以及项目级别和总结果. 整个工作流程仍然可用,而缩短的路径则在大约3至5分钟内突出了主要模式。

blocks.en: Attendees operate the device themselves. They can answer a spoken task, provide a location-related response, perform a touchscreen interaction task, complete the drawing task, and inspect the generated scores. Tasks can be skipped so that each attendee can focus on selected modalities without completing the full workflow.
blocks.zh: 观众自己操作设备. 他们可以回答一个口语任务,提供与位置相关的响应,执行触摸屏交互任务,完成绘图任务,并检查生成的分数. 可以跳过任务,这样每个参与者就可以在不完成全部工作流程的情况下,专注于选定的模式.

blocks.en: The demo requires one Android phone or tablet, standard table space, a power outlet, and Wi-Fi. The device uses its built-in microphone, touchscreen, and GPS/location service. The conference network must permit Google STT service and the remote drawing inference. Screen mirroring to an external display is optional. No camera, additional sensors, dedicated audio equipment, VR/AR hardware, or special physical space is required.
blocks.zh: 演示需要一台Android手机或平板电脑,标准表空间,一个出电口,以及Wi-Fi. 该设备使用其内置麦克风,触摸屏,和GPS/位置服务. 会议网络必须允许谷歌STT服务和远程绘图推论. 屏幕镜像到外部显示是可选的 。 不需要相机、额外的传感器、专用音频设备、VR/AR硬件或特殊物理空间。
